title: test/ci/fast-pass.test.ts fails intermittently in CI
body: Evidence: PR #1441 (wait-loop-guard), CI run 44342872290 attempt 1 failed in test/ci/fast-pass.test.ts (git tree test in a temp directory); attempt 2 passed with no code change.
Outcome: test/ci/fast-pass.test.ts gives the same verdict on every run under host load; the cause is found and fixed, not retried.
Proof: the failing test passes 20 consecutive runs under load (for i in $(seq 20); do node --test test/ci/fast-pass.test.ts || exit 1; done).
